ck_credential_refs_secret_ref.name: ck_credential_refs_secret_ref
ck_credential_refs_secret_ref.value: secret_ref GLOB 'secretref:*' AND length(secret_ref) BETWEEN 18 AND 74 AND secret_ref NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9_:-]*'

ck_subject_nickname_changes_hash.name: ck_subject_nickname_changes_hash
ck_subject_nickname_changes_hash.value: length(next_nickname_hash) = 64 AND (previous_nickname_hash IS NULL OR length(previous_nickname_hash) = 64)

ck_data_requests_method.name: ck_data_requests_method
ck_data_requests_method.value: verification_method IS NULL OR verification_method IN ('ACCOUNT_OWNERSHIP', 'REQUEST_AUTHORIZATION')

ck_data_requests_verified_method.name: ck_data_requests_verified_method
ck_data_requests_verified_method.value: verification_state <> 'VERIFIED' OR verification_method IS NOT NULL

ck_data_requests_mode.name: ck_data_requests_mode
ck_data_requests_mode.value: mode IS NULL OR mode IN ('DELETE_DATA_ONLY', 'DELETE_AND_EXCEPT')

ck_technical_logs_numbers.name: ck_technical_logs_numbers
ck_technical_logs_numbers.value: sequence >= 0 AND (latency_ms IS NULL OR latency_ms >= 0)

ck_technical_logs_data.name: ck_technical_logs_data
ck_technical_logs_data.value: data_json IS NULL OR (json_valid(data_json) AND length(CAST(data_json AS BLOB)) <= 2000)
